enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +9: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +9 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Necromancy Focus +6: +6 Equipment bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
Insightful Nullification +55: Passive: +55 Insightful bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.

Trap the Soul Guard: This item stores an overwhelming, merciless power deep within. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, this power occasionally comes to the surface, sucking out the life force of an enemy and imprisoning the essence of their body and soul in a gem.

Epic Saltmarsh Explorer: 5 Pieces Equipped:+20 Artifact bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Rating+10 Artifact bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power+2 Artifact bonus to all Ability Scores+20 Artifact Bonus to Positive, Negative, and Repair Amplification
